turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Welcome to Snell's Law of Refraction. When light passes from air to glass, it slows down and bends toward the normal.

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_2
turn_boundaries.text: Dr. Sarah, looking at the formula n_1 \sin i = n_2 \sin r, what's the key thing students usually trip over here?

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Great question, Alex. The big takeaway is: The ratio sin(i) to sin(r) equals the ratio of refractive indices.
